description: List the domain referrers set directly on a folder. Returns { refers: [{ id, url, type, status, origin: { type, id } }] }. library_id is resolved automatically when omitted.

folder_id.description: Folder UUID whose referrers to list

library_id.description: Library UUID. Resolved from GET /library when omitted.

name: panda_list_folder_refer
title: List Folder Domain Referrers
